models.visionCaveat: The model card states verbatim that training was text-only and the vision tower was never fine-tuned, so image-grounded reasoning inherits base Qwen3.5-9B behaviour and has not been independently evaluated.
models.contextNote: Ships YaRN rope-scaling for a 1,048,576-token window. 8192 recommended on-device; lower it to cut KV-cache memory.
models.notes: Hybrid Gated-DeltaNet architecture (3:1 SSM:attention). K-quants keep SSM state tensors at higher precision, so files run ~2-4% larger than a flat K-quant. Repo ships SHA256SUMS.
